cleanup_rule: Success removes private NVMe stage after atomic publication; failure removes large staged render bytes and retains only a bounded rejection JSON.
execution_binding_rule: Source disabled requests retain null future hashes; Root creates a separate enabled binding with source_only=false, future_input_hashes_null=false, input_files/input_sha256 populated for non-payload metadata, and reservation_id=current_attempt_id.
foreign_process_policy: Root runtime protects foreign GPU/CPU processes and owns shared leases; this wrapper never probes or stops them.
live_ledger_rule: Under resource-ledger.lock, reread resource-ledger.json limits/reservations, exclude the own reservation.id from other storage/thread/cap totals, and use the live Home floor; static request home_reserved_bytes is never used.
payload_boundary: Wrapper does not open/hash BI4/H5/CSV/DAT/VTK; Root023 is the only future CPU task that reads the registered XDMF/H5 source.
publication_rule: Under resource-ledger.lock, report/PVSM paths are recursively checked for private stage/NVMe roots, derived bytes are fixed-point capped and verified, an exclusive sibling is atomically renamed, and Home free space is rechecked after rename before success.
pvsm_rule: PVSM and JSON strings are recursively checked by path-component containment; registered trajectory H5 references remain unchanged, while private stage/NVMe paths are rejected.
trajectory_h5_reference_rule: A registered external trajectory H5 path may remain as a serialized source reference; this wrapper never opens, copies, or hashes that payload.
renderer_argv: Root732 exact pvpython --force-offscreen-rendering render_native023.py --manifest {manifest} --output-dir {stage_render}; no diagnostic-frame option
reservation_rule: Root creates the runtime reservation first; reservation_id and current_attempt_id must match before execution.
signal_rule: SIGTERM/SIGINT handlers remain installed through validation/publication; only the own renderer process group is terminated. Publication catches BaseException to remove its own temporary Home sibling and staged bytes.
staging_rule: Root023 writes all frames, contacts, GIF, and PVSM under private NVMe stage/render; stat-only monitor rejects cap/floor violations and leaves Home untouched.
